_note: Citadel of Ricks, Rick ID Services and Lost and Found. The Coordinate Chip fell into the lost and found bin. Take a Number puzzle (STORY.md): Desk Rick wants the right form, Guard Rick's password is whatever he is mad at today, Cop Rick takes shiny things as 'evidence' (the Shrimp Police badge from the lab). Clues come from the queue, Gossip Rick, the vending machine and Janitor Rick. A wrong answer sends Morty to the back of the line and his number is void. {number} is filled in with Morty's current number. do: back = back of the line, open = gate / field / cage, bribe = badge / ring / soda (ring and soda only exist after a bonus arcade run, so on the main path the badge is the answer).

arrive.speaker: Morty
arrive.text: The Citadel. A whole space station of Ricks. This is my actual nightmare.

arrive.speaker: Morty
arrive.text: Okay. The chip's here somewhere. The gun's pointing at... the lost and found. Of course it is.

goals.number: Take a number. The machine by the window.
goals.desk: Your number is up. Probably. Talk to Desk Rick.
goals.guard: Get past Guard Rick and his force field.
goals.cop: Get Cop Rick away from the lost and found cage.
goals.chip: Grab the Coordinate Chip from the bin.

hint: SPACE: talk or look. Ricks in the line know things.
backToast: Back of the line. Your number is void. Take a new one.
got: GOT: THE COORDINATE CHIP. GUN PART 3 OF 3. FULL POWER.

lines.speaker: Number Machine
lines.text: TAKE A NUMBER. YOUR NUMBER IS: {number}.

lines.speaker: Number Machine
lines.text: NOW SERVING: 4,000,112. ESTIMATED WAIT: HEAT DEATH OF THE UNIVERSE.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Cool. Cool cool cool.

lines.speaker: Number Machine
lines.text: WELCOME BACK. YOUR NEW NUMBER IS: {number}.

lines.speaker: Number Machine
lines.text: YOUR OLD NUMBER HAS BEEN SHREDDED. IT FELT NOTHING.

lines.speaker: Number Machine
lines.text: YOU ALREADY HAVE A NUMBER: {number}. HOLD ON TO IT. EMOTIONALLY.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: No number, no existence. The machine. By the window. I'll wait. I'm great at waiting.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: {number}... ugh, whatever, you're up. The line's a social construct anyway.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: Lost and found requires the correct form. Which form, genius?

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: 22-B. With the B. Do you know how rare that is?

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: I'm gonna stamp this so hard. Go. Before I start feeling something.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: 22. Just 22. No B. You walked up to my desk and said a number without its letter.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: Back of the line. Think about what you did.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: An emergency! Wonderful. That's Form 1. It's nine hundred pages. Single-spaced.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: Fill it out at the back of the line.

lines.speaker: Desk Rick
lines.text: You're processed. Stop being in front of my desk. It's unprocessing you.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: You're on the wrong side of the railing to even talk to me, kid.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: Every Rick here thinks he's the smart one. I'm the smart one.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: Password. And it better not be something stupid like 'password'.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: ...It ate four Flurbos, kid. Four. Do you know what that does to a man?

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: You get it. Go through. Kick it on your way out.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: The Council? I'm mad at them every day. That's not a password, that's a lifestyle.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: Back of the line.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: I said not 'password'. You said 'password' with a question mark. That's worse.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: Back of the line.

lines.speaker: Guard Rick
lines.text: Did you kick the machine? Kick the machine.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Lost and found is closed. Police business.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Unless you've got something for me. For the... investigation.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: A badge. From a shrimp. That's interdimensional evidence. The best kind.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Cage is open. I'm pinning this on. Nobody saw anything.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Ooh. Evidence. Very important evidence. Of a crime. Somewhere.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: I didn't see you. You didn't see me. Nobody saw the ring.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Blips and Chitz soda. This is evidence of a very good night.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Confiscated. Go on. The cage is open. I'm busy. Drinking evidence.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: There goes my fight soda. Worth it. Probably.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Justice? Kid, I'm a cop at the Citadel. That's adorable. Back of the line.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: That's a sandwich. Half of one. That's not evidence, that's lunch. Back of the line.

lines.speaker: Cop Rick
lines.text: Move along. Nothing to see. Especially not the evidence.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: The Coordinate Chip! In a lost and found bin, next to forty identical lab coats.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: I've been next in line for three weeks. I can feel it. Any day now.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: Lost and found? You need a 22-B.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: Not a 22. A 22-B. Everyone forgets the B. Desk Rick lives for people who forget the B.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: I came in to complain about the line.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: Now I'm in the line. The system works. I hate that it works.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: Pro tip: don't say 'emergency' to Desk Rick.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: He has a form for emergencies. It's nine hundred pages. He gets so happy.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: I'm here because I lost my Morty.

lines.speaker: Queue Rick
lines.text: Well. He left. So technically I'm the lost item. I'm in the wrong line.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Morty! Look at this. I'm number 4,000,113. They're serving 4,000,112. I'm NEXT.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Dad, how are you at the Citadel? You don't even have a portal gun!

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: I'm pitching. Do Ricks need life insurance? Asking for a pitch.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: They keep saying 'there's infinite of me'. I think that's a no. I've been next for six hours.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Still next! Any minute now.

lines.speaker: Gossip Rick
lines.text: Psst. Guard Rick's password? It's always whatever he's mad at today.

lines.speaker: Gossip Rick
lines.text: He changes it every day. He's mad at something new every day. Honestly impressive.

lines.speaker: Gossip Rick
lines.text: Today he walked in here and stared at that vending machine for an hour.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: A vending machine. SOLD OUT of everything, including the sign that says SOLD OUT.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Someone scratched into the side: 'YOU ATE MY FLURBOS. YOU ARE DEAD TO ME. - G.R.'

lines.speaker: Janitor Rick
lines.text: Cop Rick? He confiscates anything shiny. Calls it 'evidence'.

lines.speaker: Janitor Rick
lines.text: You should see his locker. It's all arcade prizes. Real evidence of a sad life.

lines.speaker: Bored Rick
lines.text: I'm the Rick who waits for the Rick who relieves the Rick who guards the door.

lines.speaker: Bored Rick
lines.text: It's a whole system. Built by Ricks. For nobody.

lines.speaker: Clerk Morty
lines.text: Shh. I'm a Morty who works here. The Ricks think I'm a coat rack.

lines.speaker: Clerk Morty
lines.text: Best job I ever had. Nobody talks to coat racks.

ending.speaker: Shrimp Rick
ending.text: Found you, kid. Did you really think I couldn't follow a portal signal?

ending.speaker: Number Machine
ending.text: TAKE A NUMBER. YOUR NUMBER IS: 10,000,000,000.

ending.speaker: Shrimp Rick
ending.text: I don't take numbers. I am the smartest shrimp in any ocean!

ending.speaker: Desk Rick
ending.text: Sir. Sir. Everyone takes a number. Even shrimp. ESPECIALLY shrimp.

ending.speaker: Cop Rick
ending.text: Back of the line, pal. Don't make me write you up.

ending.speaker: Morty
ending.text: Full power. Okay. Bye, Ricks! Good luck with the line!
